rule: This manifest selects engineering candidates only. It contains no paper numeric targets and must never be mounted into an independent code-agent workspace. Numeric targets are independently extracted, reviewed, committed, and kept orchestrator-only until the frozen run is complete.
selection_principles: separate author-package rerun from independent reimplementation
prefer recent packages for blind-agent evaluation to reduce model-memory contamination risk
pin article version and every input artifact before execution
verify artifact-level access and model-egress rights before mounting data
do not use reported outcomes, author code, output files, paper URLs, or repository URLs in the independent agent view
do not treat a successful engineering shakedown as benchmark evidence

candidates.package_status: public replication package; external reproduction-platform record says enough materials are available
blockers: verify file-level Dataverse licenses and any model-egress restrictions
pin a concrete paper and replication-package version
independently extract and double-review the MethodSpecification
seal a claim-target contract without exposing numeric reported values to the agent
mitigate the high memorization risk of a widely available 2019 paper and replication package

candidates.method_family: empirical finance regression and instrumental-variable analyses
candidates.package_status: openICPSR V1 published 2026-03-27; package describes data and Stata code for all empirical analyses, tables, and figures
blockers: pin the exact forthcoming-paper version matched by replication package V1
verify artifact-level download, license, and model-egress permissions
select one narrow main-claim display item before reading author output files
independently extract and double-review the design-specific MethodSpecification
commit paper target cells before agent execution and keep them orchestrator-only
decide whether author-code rerun requires licensed Stata while independent reimplementation uses a separate supported runtime

candidates.package_status: public data-and-code candidate already present in the real-corpus sampling frame
blockers: verify the currently downloadable artifact set and exact version
seal a narrow claim-target contract before code-agent dispatch
